Video name: What gas do plants take in from the air to make their food?
column7: Plants use sunlight to turn carbon dioxide and water into sugar, and they give out oxygen.

Video name: What is the hardest natural material on Earth?
column7: Diamonds are made of carbon squeezed under huge pressure deep underground.

Video name: About how long does sunlight take to reach Earth?
column7: Light travels about 300,000 km every second, the fastest speed there is.

Video name: At what temperature does water boil at sea level?
column7: On top of Mount Everest, water boils at only about 70°C because the air is thinner.

Video name: What is the largest organ of the human body?
column7: An adult's skin weighs about 4 kg and replaces itself roughly every month.
